results.title: Earth's orbit
results.snippet: Earth orbits the Sun at an average distance of 149.60 million km (92.96 million mi), or 8.317 light-minutes, [1] in a counterclockwise direction.

results.title: When did we realize Earth orbits the Sun?
results.snippet: The idea that Earth orbits the Sun is ancient. Around 230 B.C., the Greek philosopher Aristarchus suggested that this was the case.
